description: This file defines the 'HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Text' class, which represents the XHTML 1.1 Text Module used within the HTMLPurifier library. It sets up various inline and block elements for HTML purification, including inline text elements, structural elements like paragraphs and divisions, and heading tags. The class extends a base module class and configures elements with their content models, formatting, and exclusions.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Text
classes.description: Represents the XHTML 1.1 Text Module for HTMLPurifier, defining inline and block text container elements and their configurations.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the module by adding various inline and block elements with specific configurations, including formatting and exclusion rules.
